about.heading: What is ZidMapa?
about.intro: ZidMapa is a shared map of graffiti and insulting messages on the walls of Serbian cities. Anyone can add a spot with a photo, and anyone who wants to help can see where cleaning is needed.
about.action: On 28 October 2026 students called on citizens to join a work action to clean buildings, streets, parks and facades, in their own neighbourhood or anywhere in the city. That includes the insulting slogans that have marked facades for a long time, and artists are invited to help restore them. There is no end date: it lasts until the work is done.
steps: See graffiti that should go? Take a photo with “Report graffiti”. The location is added automatically.
It appears on the map as a red pin. If someone already reported it, you confirm theirs instead.
Going out to clean? Pick red pins near you. Bring gloves, brushes, paint and bags.
Cleaned spots turn green, so everyone can see the progress.
about.privacy: Reporting is anonymous and needs no account. Location data is removed from photos before upload. Please don't photograph people.
